messages:
Jamie: Quick follow-up Q&A from today's all-hands focused on GTM: pipeline velocity, partner rollout, and packaging. Short questions only please.
Maria: Snapshot: funnel up 18% q/q but larger deals are stretching into Q4. Sharing mitigation plays shortly.
Carlos: For enterprise renewals, any flexibility on multi-year pricing to lock ARR? Procurement teams asking.
Maria: We can offer multi-year pricing with a capped discount matrix; must include auto-renew clauses and an exit SLT review for >10% discount. Sales Ops will post the matrix today.
Nia: Partner ops: willpartners get access to co-branded case studies as part of the pilot? EMEA teams want marketing assets.
Leah: Yes 1: pilot partners get co-branded case study templates and up to $5k in joint-marketing credits after first closed deal. Asset kit in partner portal next week.
Sanjay: Quick ops ask: are we standardizing how AEs log partner-influenced opps in CRM? Current tracking varies.
Leah: New rule: tag opps with "partner_origin" and include partner_id field; Sales Ops is rolling an automation to enforce this. Training video coming.
Olivia: Packaging question: can reps bundle Dedicated reserved slots with a short POC hosted plan for the first 90 days? Legal/procurement prefer staged contracts.
Maria: Yes, we have a staged-contract template: 90-day hosted POC, automatic transition to reserved SKU with prorated billing. Legal template will be in the docs library.
Jamie: Forecast cadence change: show top-15 deals weekly in the pipeline report starting next Tuesday. Push RFC updates to #g2m-ops by Monday.
Carlos: One-liner for exec decks about quantization savings for proposals? Need something punchy for CFOs.
Olivia: Use: "Redwood's model profiles and quantization options can cut inference spend by up to ~40% on steady-state workloads without degrading output quality."
all-hands-bot: Reminder: recording, deck, and action-item tracker uploaded to the all-hands folder within 24h.
Jamie: Thanks everyone. If you need deeper follow-ups, ping the owners or add here and we'll surface in next week's GTM huddle. :sparkles:
